sam-devx: FYI ran the samplekit onboarding e2e and hit a subtle one: tool/fncall schema enforcement drops after an auth retry. First call rejects extra fields, retry accepts them.

lee-sdk: ouch. minimal repro?

sam-devx: flow: initial request -> 401 -> SDK auto-retry -> retry path recreates helper from factory that reads env defaults, so strictSchema=false on retry. Example: `const client = new SDK({ jsonMode: true, strictSchema: true, helperFactory: makeH }); client.callTool('profile', p);` Retry does `h = makeH()` and loses strict flag.

narah-qa: customer reported downstream parse failure because fncall output shape differed. I can reproduce by toggling DEFAULT_STRICT in CI and forcing a 401 on first try.

lee-sdk: probable parity/config bug across runtimes. Quick mitigation: make RetryClient capture and reuse original helper opts (shallow clone) for retries. I'll open a small PR.

sam-devx: can we also add a lightweight samplekit lint that warns if helper factories read env for opt defaults? would prevent future patterns.

narah-qa: and add an invariant e2e: run onboarding with simulated 401 and assert final tool output still fails validation when invalid. I'll add it to the e2e matrix.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for samplekit-dedicated at 2026-03-25T09:00Z.

lee-sdk: plan: patch RetryClient to thread opts (strictSchema, jsonMode, schema), unit tests for retry, samplekit e2e, lint rule, and a short docs note "Retry re-instantiation hazard" under SDK helpers. Tagging @narah-qa for test review.

sam-devx: thanks 97 please include a quick dev note in the samplekit README so teams know to preserve opts across retries. :thumbsup:
